title: Bucket Wheel Excavator

introduction.definition: A bucket wheel excavator (BWE) is a continuous mining machine used in large open-cast mines. A rotating wheel of buckets on the end of a boom cuts overburden, lignite or coal from the bench as the boom slews. The material falls onto the boom conveyor and is transferred through the machine to the discharge boom, which loads the mine's belt conveyor system. Crawler tracks move the machine.
applications: Large earth-moving projects in soft-to-medium material
introduction.summary: A bucket wheel excavator (BWE) is a giant continuous mining machine. Buckets on the rotating wheel cut material from the bench as the boom slews; the material drops onto belt conveyors in the boom and leaves via the discharge boom to the mine conveyor system. Crawlers move the machine.

foundation: Prepared, levelled bench with adequate ground-bearing capacity for crawler pressure; drainage of the working level.
alignment: Plan bench height and block width to match wheel diameter and boom reach.
piping: Power by trailing cable from a mine substation via cable reel; communications with conveyor control.
commissioning: Assemble and test each drive; check slew/luff brakes, wheel overload protection and collision sensors; trial digging.

routine.task: Inspect bucket teeth and lips, wheel chute and belts.

periodic.task: Inspect crawler pads, rollers and drive.

lubrication: Gearboxes: oil to grade and change interval; open gears and slew bearing: grease to schedule.
Wheels and pulley bearings: grease to schedule.

safety: Exclusion zones; slope stability; trailing-cable management; lightning and wind limits.

video_tutorials.title: Bucket Wheel Excavator — Introduction

script.narration: This module introduces the Bucket Wheel Excavator.
A bucket wheel excavator (BWE) is a continuous mining machine used in large open-cast mines.
A rotating wheel of buckets on the end of a boom cuts overburden, lignite or coal from the bench as the boom slews.
The material falls onto the boom conveyor and is transferred through the machine to the discharge boom, which loads the mine's belt conveyor system.
Typical applications include lignite and brown-coal open-cast mines; overburden removal; large earth-moving projects in soft-to-medium material.
The cutaway reveals the internal construction: Bucket Wheel (digs material and drops it on the boom conveyor).
The exploded view separates every component so each one can be tapped for its function, material and failure modes.
Next, watch the operation tutorial to see how it works.

video_tutorials.title: Bucket Wheel Excavator — Maintenance

script.narration: Maintenance essentials for the Bucket Wheel Excavator.
Inspect bucket teeth and lips, wheel chute and belts.
Inspect crawler pads, rollers and drive.
Structural inspections (NDT) of boom and mast; slew bearing.
Watch for tooth/bucket wear: high wheel power, falling output. Common cause: abrasive or hard material.
Watch for crawler damage: broken pads, track derailing. Common cause: soft ground, rocks.
Record every inspection so trends — vibration, temperature, leakage and performance — can be compared over time.
